Private wb As Object

Public Sub Setup()
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
End Sub

Public Function S0() As String
    Dim ws As Object, c As Object, before As Variant, after As Variant, e As Long
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    Set c = ws.Range("B2")
    On Error Resume Next
    before = c.ColumnWidth
    Err.Clear
    c.ColumnWidth = 20
    e = Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    after = c.ColumnWidth
    S0 = "e" & e & "|" & IIf(before = after, "same", "changed")
End Function
